risks.title: Cyber-attacks and AI-enabled Security Vulnerabilities
risks.score_rationale: Positioned as primary risk with repeated mention of extended threats (hacking, AI, DDoS), strong language ('cascading impacts', 'adversely affect'), existential risk to reputation and operational continuity, highest priority security category.
risks.summary: Cyber-attacks amplified by AI and sophisticated threats pose existential risks to customer data security, system integrity, and competitive positioning.
risks.description: Cyber-attacks amplified by AI and sophisticated threats pose existential risks to customer data security, system integrity, and competitive positioning. Une intrusion réussie pourrait perturber l'activité et la confiance des clients.

risks.title: Dependence on AWS and Third-Party Cloud Providers
risks.score_rationale: Presented as critical with reference to past AWS outages, direct impact on cloud service availability, difficulty of failover, mention of revenue losses and contractual liabilities.
risks.summary: Outage or rupture with AWS or a third-party hosting provider could interrupt cloud services and harm client operations and revenue.
risks.description: Outage or rupture with AWS or a third-party hosting provider could interrupt cloud services and harm client operations and revenue. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Open Source Software Licensing and IP Risks
risks.score_rationale: Serious legal and operational risk from potential disclosure of proprietary code, mention of costly re-engineering, less frequent than cyber risks but significant technology category impact.
risks.summary: Failure to properly manage open source licenses could compel disclosure of proprietary code or require costly remediation efforts.
risks.description: Failure to properly manage open source licenses could compel disclosure of proprietary code or require costly remediation efforts. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Third-Party Vendor and Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Multiple mentions of contractual, financial and operational risks from third parties including subcontractors, with reference to revenue losses and contract breaches, strong language ('jeopardized', 'adversely affected').
risks.summary: Failure of a key vendor or subcontractor could compromise delivery, contract performance and client relationships.
risks.description: Failure of a key vendor or subcontractor could compromise delivery, contract performance and client relationships. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Product Quality and New Release Defects
risks.score_rationale: Recurring risk from software complexity, mention of revenue losses and adoption delays, mitigated by contractual provisions but persistent in initial releases and updates.
risks.summary: Defects in new products or updates could delay adoption, harm client satisfaction and impact revenue growth.
risks.description: Defects in new products or updates could delay adoption, harm client satisfaction and impact revenue growth. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Rapid Technological Change and Product Obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Alarming language ('render our existing products obsolete'), mention of rapid changes in standards and client needs, direct impact on competitiveness and market share.
risks.summary: Inability to keep pace with technological evolution could render products obsolete and result in loss of market share.
risks.description: Inability to keep pace with technological evolution could render products obsolete and result in loss of market share. Cet enjeu reste à surveiller dans la trajectoire du groupe.

risks.title: Unauthorized Internal AI Tool Usage and Data Leakage
risks.score_rationale: Emerging AI-specific risk with threat of involuntary disclosure of intellectual property, specific mention and concerned language ('increase the risk'), expanding cybersecurity category.
risks.summary: Uncontrolled use of generative AI by employees could result in unintended disclosure of confidential information and proprietary data.
risks.description: Uncontrolled use of generative AI by employees could result in unintended disclosure of confidential information and proprietary data. Une intrusion réussie pourrait perturber l'activité et la confiance des clients.
